subject.title: [Feature]: Load macOS onboarding providers from Gateway catalog

question: Should macOS Connect your AI manual API-key setup become a catalog-backed provider-auth flow through `crestodian.setup.detect` and `crestodian.setup.activate`, or should non-core providers stay outside guided app onboarding for now?
rationale: This is a new first-run macOS/Gateway protocol surface with provider-auth ownership implications, and the protected `maintainer` label means automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Implement catalog-backed macOS setup
options.body: Extend the Gateway setup RPCs additively and render provider-owned text-inference API-key choices in the macOS app.

options.title: Keep the three-provider picker
options.body: Leave app onboarding limited to Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google while other providers use CLI or plugin setup paths.

options.title: Split protocol design first
options.body: Keep this issue open for product direction and open a narrower Gateway setup-contract design task before implementation.

recommendation.title: Implement catalog-backed macOS setup
recommendation.body: Extend the Gateway setup RPCs additively and render provider-owned text-inference API-key choices in the macOS app.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current onboarding/RPC surface and opened the catalog-backed replacement request.
